points.quote: Next to it, create the identifier with `createDecorator<IFooService>('fooService')` ... The convention is to export a `const` with the same name as the interface
use `instantiationService.createInstance(MyClass, ...nonServiceArgs)`. A class created this way gets its decorated parameters filled in automatically.
These calls usually sit in a `*.main.ts` or `*.contribution.ts` file. For example, `src/vs/workbench/workbench.common.main.ts:181` registers `IContextViewService`.
